issues.title: 01 Bootstrap Vite React TypeScript app shell
issues.body:
## Type
chore

## Intent
Das Repo bekommt eine lauffähige Vite+React+TypeScript-App mit Tailwind, path aliases und `npm run checks`, damit alle späteren Slices einen App-Root haben.

## Goal
`npm run dev` starts on http://localhost:5173; `npm run checks` runs lint, tsc --noEmit, vitest, build, and npm audit --audit-level=high.

## Non-Goals
- No business UI beyond a German placeholder shell
- No Supabase, React Flow, or domain logic
- No DaisyUI / Next.js

## Context
- Existing: `PRD.md` §14, `ARCHITECTURE.md` §3, `AGENTS.md` stack table
- Reuse: none (greenfield code)
- Links: `.qa/design/v1-mvp-delivery.md`

## Scope
In:
- `package.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `tsconfig*.json`, `index.html`
- `src/app/**`, `src/main.tsx`, `src/shared/ui/` (empty index OK)
- `eslint`/`prettier` configs, `scripts/run-checks.sh`, `.env.example`
Out:
- `src/core/**`, `src/features/**`, `supabase/**`

## Security & Data
- No secrets in repo; `.env.example` documents only public Vite vars for later
- Secure-by-Default: P-01 (audit in checks)

## Edge Cases
- Missing Node 20+ fails with clear engine message in README
- `checks` fails closed if any step fails

## Acceptance
- [ ] Vite React TS app boots; German placeholder page at `/`
- [ ] Tailwind + path alias `@/` → `src/` configured
- [ ] `npm run checks` = lint + typecheck + vitest + build + `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Runner
Labels: P0, agent-ready
Feature slug: `bootstrap-vite-app`
Design: .qa/design/v1-mvp-delivery.md

## Goal
`src/core/money` and `src/core/periods` exist as pure TS with deterministic unit tests; no React imports.

## Non-Goals
- No UI formatting components
- No FX rates / multi-currency conversion beyond mismatch rejection
- No persistence

## Context

- Decision: `decimal.js`, HALF_UP display 2 dp, internal ≥8, default currency EUR
- Links: `.qa/design/v1-mvp-delivery.md`

In:
- `src/core/money/**`
- `src/core/periods/**`
- `tests/core/money*`, `tests/core/periods*`
Out:

- Secure-by-Default: none beyond typed inputs

- [ ] Period types Day|Week|Month|Quarter|Year; Month default helper
- [ ] Vitest covers rounding, mismatch, and at least one native-basis conversion
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Goal
Given a fixture model, `evaluate(model, context)` returns typed results with direct vs allocated provenance hooks and cycle rejection.

## Non-Goals

- No formulas parser (next issue; allow placeholder formulaRef)
- No funnels/scenarios UI

issues.title: 04 Restricted formula engine AST parse and evaluate
dependsOn: 03 Core domain model and calculation engine
issues.body:
## Type
feature

## Intent
Sichere Formelsprache zum Anzeigen/Editieren von Defaults ohne JavaScript-Execution (FR-023–025, FR-024, FE-01).

## Goal
Parser/evaluator supports only `+ - * / % () SUM AVG MIN MAX ROUND IF`; rejects unsafe input; integrates with calculation via formulaRef.

## Non-Goals
- No formula editor UI (later workbench)
- No user-defined custom functions
- No spreadsheet compatibility beyond listed ops

## Context
- Existing: `src/core/calculation`
- Locked surface: ARCHITECTURE.md §5 formulas
- Links: SCN-018, SCN-019

## Scope
In:
- `src/core/formulas/**`
- `tests/core/formulas*`
- Wire calculation to call evaluator when formula present
Out:
- Feature UI, Monaco/editor packages

## Security & Data
- Hostile input: no eval/new Function; FE-01…FE-03
- Secure-by-Default: F-02 at domain boundary

## Edge Cases
- `alert(1)`, `window.`, backticks, imports → reject
- Divide by zero → Unresolved
- Unknown symbol → Unresolved
- Cyclic formula deps → reject (C-03)

## Acceptance
- [ ] Parse→AST→evaluate for allowed ops/functions with Vitest matrix
- [ ] Security tests prove eval/new Function paths absent and unsafe strings rejected
- [ ] Reset-to-default supported at data level (`source: default|custom`)
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Runner
Labels: P0, agent-ready
Feature slug: `core-formula-engine`
Design: .qa/design/v1-mvp-delivery.md

issues.body:
## Type
feature

## Intent
Supabase Auth + versionierte Migrations + RLS ersetzen Local-only für Owner-Daten (FR-031, A-001, D-005).

## Goal
Authenticated owner can CRUD own rows only; anon denied; remote repository implements same ports; service role never in client.

## Non-Goals
- No multi-member workspaces
- No custom auth
- No migrating unrelated features' UI

## Context
- `supabase/migrations/`
- Tables: workspaces, businesses, products, models, funnels, scenarios, custom_templates, period_values
- Env: VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

## Scope
In:
- `supabase/migrations/**`
- `src/integrations/supabase/**`
- Auth UI (sign-in/up) German
- Repository switch: remote when session present
Out:
- Full offline sync engine / CRDT

## User Journey
1. Nutzer registriert sich
2. Legt Business an → erscheint in Supabase unter seiner owner_id
3. Anderer User sieht diese Rows nicht

## Security & Data
- RLS owner policies deny-by-default (B-02, B-08, S-03)
- No service role in client (F-05, S-04)
- Managed Supabase Auth only (B-01)
- Secure-by-Default: B-01, B-02, B-04, B-08, B-09, F-03, F-05

## Edge Cases
- Expired session on save → keep unsaved local edits + re-auth prompt (U-04)
- Cross-user read returns empty/deny

## Acceptance
- [ ] Migrations + RLS policies; Vitest/integration or documented SQL policy tests prove cross-user deny
- [ ] Sign-in/up/out German UI; session not stored as raw password/token in localStorage beyond Supabase SSR-safe patterns
- [ ] Remote adapter implements businesses/products ports behind feature index
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)
